invariants: The backend allows exactly one 'active' order per user at a time — GET /orders/active returns a single order, not a list, and calling it has the side effect of expiring a depleted plan server-side (f016).

Next route handlers must live under src/app/bff/**, never src/app/api/** — nginx proxies the whole /api/* prefix straight to Express in production, so anything under app/api/ is silently unreachable there even though it works in dev (f003).
getBackendApiUrl() defaults to the PRODUCTION backend (https://esim.uplisoft.com/api) even under `next dev` — local dev against a local backend requires explicitly setting BACKEND_API_URL (f004).
readEmailFromAccessToken() is unverified (no signature check possible client-side) — display only, never treat its output as an authorization decision (f008).

Any redirect URL built from `request.url`/`url.origin` inside a route handler or middleware will leak the internal bind address (localhost:3020) in production; always derive origin via getPublicOrigin(request) instead (f009).

NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_SERVICES_ID must be an Apple Services ID, never a bundle id or a Google client id — the SocialSignInButtons render guard only checks non-empty, so a wrong-but-present value renders a button that fails at runtime (f012, f013).
.env.local is gitignored and never reaches production; update.sh deploys via git pull + build, so any NEXT_PUBLIC_* value that must exist in prod has to also be committed in .env.production (f029).

Shared Button/LinkButton (src/app/components/Button.tsx, buttonClasses.ts) is the canonical CTA component, mirroring mobile's resolveButtonVisual — new buttons should use resolveButtonClasses() rather than hand-rolled Tailwind strings (f032).

The display font is Hanken Grotesk (not Plus Jakarta Sans) and all three font families (Hanken Grotesk/Inter/Geist) are loaded via next/font/google in src/app/layout.tsx — declaring a font CSS variable in tailwind.config.ts alone does not load it (f033, f034).
